audit.why: Both layers already agree row for row, and the why-text matches every side value. Our packet (260 games, 51.54%) gives Warwick all seven rows; the current chart is slightly more conservative at levels 1 and 6, which the kit supports — Blooming Burst out-ranges you at 1 and Pop Blossom is a real level-6 threat.
audit.corrected: Left unchanged. The mirror's proposed all-Neeko chart is flagged for the user rather than applied — see notes.

audit.whatIsWrong: First-item spike leaned on Blood Hunt seeing through her clones.
audit.why: Blood Hunt senses enemies below 50% health for speed and attack speed; nothing in Riot's text says it reveals Inherent Glamour disguises or picks the real Neeko out of a Shapesplitter clone. That is an invented mechanic.
audit.corrected: Re-keyed the spike to Shapesplitter's 16-12s cooldown buying her nothing once you are inside her 800-range poke.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text said Infinite Duress 'channels through her Pop Blossom windup' and called Warwick's Q an auto reset.
audit.why: Infinite Duress is flagged interruptible — any CC cancels it, so Tangle-Barbs' root (12/11.5/11/10.5/10s) stops the leap dead. That is the decisive interaction and it ran the wrong way in the text. Jaws of the Beast is a 365-range lunge, not an auto reset. Riot's own passive text does give a verified interaction the page was missing: immobilising crowd control breaks her disguise, and Infinite Duress' suppression qualifies.
audit.corrected: Root-cancels-your-leap is now the spine of the level-6 text, the false Q reset is gone, and the disguise-break is stated.

notes: Chart left alone deliberately. The mirror (neeko/warwick) pushed every row to Neeko off a 14-game, 100% sample and its own author marked that Medium confidence; our packet is 260 games at 51.54% with Warwick favoured on every row, and both layers here already agree with each other. Flipping to the mirror would contradict the win rate shown on the same page. Whether Infinite Duress' suppression can cancel Pop Blossom once she has already leapt is not in Riot's text; I wrote only that you suppress during the wind-up.
